thread:
Maria: Ok team — after the Sev2 yesterday we should assemble a focused Grafana dashboard for the retro. Goal: surface paging noise, customer impact slices, and alert thresholds we changed. Who can help put panels together?

Jon: I can take latency + p95/p99 panels and add a timeline of deploys.

Lin: I’ll do alert-counts, dedupe trends, and a small panel showing which alerts fired and for how long.

incident-bot: Incident #2026-152 triggered 3164928000 (Sev2). Paging: 3 on-call pages. Customer impact: degraded API tail latency for 12m.

Maria: Thanks — important to include:
- Golden signals overview (latency, error rate, throughput)
- Alert firing timeline (stacked) + per-alert durations
- Paging heatmap (who got paged when)
- Customer-impact drilldown: by tenant / region if available
- Config / threshold change note (who changed what and when)

Kevin: I can wire the paging heatmap using the paging_events metric and our slack-notify label. Quick PromQL idea: 
```
sum by (user, bin) (increase(redwood_oncall_paging_events_total[1h]))
```
I'll translate to a heatmap panel.

Ashley: For customer impact drilldown I can add a table panel with: tenant_id, requests_5m, p95_latency_5m, errors_5m. Query sketch: 
```
sum by(tenant_id) (increase(redwood_requests_total[5m]))
quantile_over_time(0.95, redwood_request_latency_seconds[5m]) by (tenant_id)
```
We don't have quantile_over_time in Prom, will approximate with histogram_quantile on buckets.

Jon: For latency panel queries I'll use: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_service_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
sum(rate(redwood_service_requests_total[5m])) by (route)
```
And add vertical markers for deploy times.

Lin: For alert counts: 
```
sum(increase(alertmanager_alerts_received_total[1h])) by (alertname)
```
Also want a panel that shows alerts that were silenced or disabled during the incident. We'll pull alertmanager state via labels.

Maria: Nice. Two UX asks: 1) make the golden signals panel compact with comparison to baseline (previous 7d) 2) add an obvious drilldown link on tenant table rows to open the logs workspace for that tenant.

oncall-bot: @Maria — handoff reminder in 30m.

Kevin: Suggest adding a dedupe rate metric: alerts_fired_per_unique_signature / alerts_total to show noise. Lin you can join that with alert duration to prioritize tuning.

Lin: Good call. I'll add a small derived stat: 
```
( sum(increase(alerts_fired_total[1h])) by (signature) ) / ignoring(signature) sum(increase(alerts_fired_total[1h]))
```
(not final query, will refine).

Maria: Ownership and timeline:
- Jon: latency + deploy markers — due EOD today.
- Lin: alert-count + dedupe + silenced-alert panel — due EOD.
- Kevin: paging heatmap + on-call sequence panel — tomorrow morning.
- Ashley: tenant drilldown + logs link — tomorrow morning.
Maria: I'll draft the retro slides from this dashboard and link metrics to the postmortem.

Jon: One more panel: KV cache hit ratio for model-serving path — that correlated with tail latency. Query: 
```
sum(rate(redwood_kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_kv_cache_requests_total[5m]))
```

Lin: Also add an alert tuning recommendation section in the dashboard: quick bullets per alert with proposed threshold or remove if noisy. I'll add a markdown panel.

Ashley: For drilldowns, note the limitation — tenant_id isn't present on all logs. I'll add a note and a fallback to region-level.

Maria: Perfect. After panels are in, let's run the dashboard in the war-room for 15 mins of live review next retro. Can we capture a screenshot and attach to the postmortem?

Kevin: Yep. I'll snapshot and export JSON panel config to the retro Google Drive folder.

incident-bot: Incident #2026-152 closed at 3164932720. Postmortem assigned to @Maria.

Maria: Thanks everyone — will ping when I create the dashboard and add links. :thumbsup:
